notes: Beverage Control has an All brands switch: it lists every brand, grouped by category, with empty Opening and Closing boxes — for typing a new month or a fresh start. Off, it shows only items that already have figures, as before. The period (FROM → TO) can now be changed from Purchase, Bar Stock Issue, Liquor Room, Dashboard and Reports, not only the Tally Sheet. Beverage Control counts the Bar Stock Issues inside those dates as its receipt, exactly like the Excel; every other figure keeps counting all entries as before.
